description: Normative Place.kind vocabulary and custodian internality of acceptance fixtures (contracts/fixture-place-kinds.md). Aligned with the product vocabulary of docs/execution/s2-inventory/contracts.md (moveQuantity), the read-only custody rule of backend QualityEligibility.custody/FulfillmentCommands.requireWarehouse and the receipt rule of ReceiptStockPrimitives.receive. ./verify prepare (ContractValidator.placeKindProblems) rejects a fixture Place without a kind, a kind outside this list and an internal-storage segment without an internal custodian; (ContractValidator.receiptCustodyProblems) rejects a transit receipt whose leaf is not an identified exact-quantity leaf at a TRANSIT place, and a direct receipt whose stock is later reserved, picked, dispatched or moved without an explicit, evidenced internal receiving custodian unless the receipt is a declared custody negative.
productRefs: docs/execution/s2-inventory/contracts.md (moveQuantity: both Place.kind INTERNAL_STORAGE and a confirmed internal custodian)

backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/application/quality/QualityEligibility.java (custody: INTERNAL_STORAGE+internal custodian CONFIRMED; TRANSIT/CUSTOMER/SUPPLIER/EXTERNAL_* OUTSIDE; any other kind UNRECOGNIZED -> UNKNOWN, eligible 0)
backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/domain/inventory/InventoryRepository.java (internalCustodian: an actor of the organization of kind HUMAN or AGENT)

backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/application/trade/receipt/ReceiptCommands.java (confirmReceipt: optional receivingCustodianId only on a direct receipt; the slot is looked up among the confirming organization's actors, else REJECTED FORBIDDEN; it must be an internal HUMAN/AGENT (else SCOPE_INELIGIBLE) with current confirmReceipt authority for the receipt's TARGET/ITEM/PLACE/WORK (else SCOPE_INELIGIBLE); the verified chains of the receipt's canonical occurrence (TradeEvidence.verifiedCanonical) that state custody must name the same custodian, else HELD EVIDENCE_CONFLICT/EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED; a transit receipt keeps the transit leaf's custody and rejects the slot)

backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/domain/inventory/ReceiptStockPrimitives.java (receive: destination Place.kind INTERNAL_STORAGE; a transit receipt consumes exactly one identified (identificationStatus CONFIRMED) leaf at a TRANSIT place with the same item, LOT, unit and exactly the received quantity, else INVALID 'Exact identified transit leaf required; split partial cargo first'; the received segment keeps the leaf owner and custodian)
docs/execution/s3-receipt/contracts.md (transitSegmentId: exact same item/LOT/quantity/unit TRANSIT leaf; partial cargo is split first)

kinds.meaning: Controlled internal storage of the fixture organization (warehouse). Stock here is in confirmed custody only when its segment names an internal custodian; only then can other conditions make it sale/dispatch eligible.
In transport (vessel, truck, carrier leg). Held history, never sale-eligible stock; eligibility is a known 0.
A customer's place (delivered or customer site). Outside internal custody; eligibility is a known 0.
A supplier's or origin place before handover. Outside internal custody; eligibility is a known 0.
A port, customs or bonded area outside internal custody (declared EXTERNAL_* kind). Eligibility is a known 0.

unrecognizedKindControl.meaning: Explicit negative control: the Place deliberately carries a kind outside this vocabulary (not starting with EXTERNAL_) so the case can assert that the product reports eligibility UNKNOWN with eligible 0 instead of a known 0 or a positive quantity. Only allowed with that kind; a fixture never relies on an undeclared kind.

directReceiptCustody.meaning: A confirmReceipt that is not a transit receipt (transitReceipt) is a direct receipt: there is no transit leaf whose custody it could keep, so the received stock's custodian comes only from the command slot. Without it the received segment has no custodian, so a conforming product rejects reserve/pick/dispatch/move of that stock with SCOPE_INELIGIBLE and reports its eligibility UNKNOWN. A case that later uses that stock names the receiving custodian explicitly (step2r round 7); a case may instead declare a custody negative (custodyControl).
rules: The slot names a fixture actor (an actors entry) of the confirming actor's organizationAlias, else the product answers REJECTED FORBIDDEN; the actor is a fixture alias of an internalCustodianAliasTypes type holding confirmReceipt in roleCapabilities and grant.actions, with the receipt place in its grant place scope when that scope lists places, else SCOPE_INELIGIBLE.

At least one verification-basis original of the receipt's canonical occurrence names the same alias and no such original names another. Verification-basis originals (step2r round 9) are the DocumentVersion aliases the receipt names in a verificationBasisSlots slot (evidenceId, evidenceIds, verifiedEvidenceIds) as {"$alias":...}, typed {"value":...} or a plain alias name, the evidence an earlier action attached at runtime when such a slot cites its $result (the DocumentVersion aliases of its document or basis slots, and an inline JSON document whose receivingCustodianAlias it states), and the same for every earlier confirmReceipt of the same canonicalOccurrenceKey (a duplicate source adds a verified chain of the same occurrence). Request-level evidenceRefs and other slots are witnesses, not verification bases: the product reads custodians only from the verified chains of the canonical occurrence (ReceiptCommands.evidencedCustodians, TradeEvidence.verifiedCanonical). A DocumentVersion names the custodian in fixtureContent.receivingCustodianAlias and its fixture evidence sha256 is the SHA-256 of its canonical content (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8); an inline document's sha256 is the SHA-256 of its content. The adapter installs each verification-basis original as a verified chain of the receipt's canonical occurrence and that alias as receivingCustodianId of the original and of the event payload.

Every confirmReceipt of the same receipt (same canonicalOccurrenceKey, else the same commandIdempotencyKey) that is not a declared custody negative carries the same slot value or none, so a retry or a duplicate source cannot change custody.
A transit receipt never carries the slot; it keeps the leaf's custodian. When its stock is used later, that leaf custodian is an internal custodian.

custodyControl.meaning: Declared custody negative on a confirmReceipt action that carries the slot (step2r rounds 8-9): the case asserts that a conforming product refuses the receiving custodian. The declared value must be the product's first failing check for that slot (ReceiptCommands: FORBIDDEN when the slot is not an actor of the confirming organization, then SCOPE_INELIGIBLE at preparation, then EVIDENCE_CONFLICT when the verification-basis originals name different custodians, then EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED when they do not name exactly the slot custodian); the subcase pins /response/outcome and /response/error/code of that action, asserts zero effect with a count 0 over /data/rawRows/segments or /data/rawRows/receipts of a later observe action, and never uses that receipt's stock.

transitReceipt.meaning: A confirmReceipt that names a fixture QuantitySegment in its slots (as {"$alias":...} or typed {"value":{"$alias":...}}), or the $result /response/children/<alias>/segmentId of an earlier splitQuantity whose source is such a leaf (or such a child), is a transit receipt. A conforming product (ReceiptStockPrimitives.receive, read only) accepts it only for exactly one identified leaf at a TRANSIT-kind Place with the same item, LOT and unit and exactly the received quantity, into an INTERNAL_STORAGE destination; partial cargo is split first (plan §4.2 '부분 이동·보류·출고는 먼저 범위가 구별되도록 분할한다', docs/execution/s3-receipt/contracts.md). An EXTERNAL_PORT, SUPPLIER or CUSTOMER leaf, or a partial quantity of a leaf, is rejected INVALID, so a case that names one cannot pass a conforming product (Step 2 closure review 5, P2).
rules: Exactly one leaf; its Place (locationAlias or placeAlias, alias or baseline.segments row) is a Place alias of kind TRANSIT.
The leaf is identified: identifiability, when present, is not INDISTINGUISHABLE_MIXTURE and identificationStatus, when present, is CONFIRMED.
The receipt quantity slot (value and unit) equals the leaf quantity and unit as decimals; a split child carries the quantity and unit of its children entry.
The receipt itemId and lotId aliases, when present, equal the leaf itemAlias and lotAlias.
The receipt place (placeId, destinationId or locationId alias) is a Place alias of kind INTERNAL_STORAGE.
